title: 自动反馈提升同伴导师的对话行为与学习者推理，但未改变发言比例
summary: 在Schoolhouse.world的SAT数学训练营中，对1,030名志愿导师开展随机对照试验。自动反馈使导师引导学习者表达想法、采纳学习者贡献及学习者推理提升8-15%，但导师发言时间（对照组91.5%）未变，面向学习者的反馈也无额外效果。
summary_en: A randomized controlled trial with 1,030 volunteer tutors on Schoolhouse.world found automated feedback increased tutors' eliciting of learner ideas, uptake, and learner reasoning by 8-15%, but tutor talk time (91.5% in control) did not change, and learner-facing feedback had no additional effect.
